== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[At Peace (V) (Virtual Block 6)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. A change of capital letters alone is a change of text (Bill, 26 November 2026). See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
